description: This PHP script is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically used to rebuild and update relationships between modules in the CRM system. It performs operations such as deleting existing relationship data, re-creating relationship metadata based on module definitions, and updating relationship caches.

classes.name: Relationship
classes.description: A class managing the relationships between CRM modules, including cache management and relationship building functions.

classes.name: SugarBean
classes.description: A base class representing a generic CRM entity, providing methods like createRelationshipMeta.

methods.name: build_relationship_cache
methods.description: Method to rebuild the relationship cache for a specific relationship object.

methods.name: createRelationshipMeta
methods.description: Static method to create or update relationship metadata in the database based on module bean definitions.
